Medicare Part A.typical_fit_note: Generally workable for short-stay skilled rehab when skilled need and qualifying hospital stay are documented.

Medicare Advantage.typical_fit_note: Often requires plan authorization before admission; missing auth creates delay risk.

Medicaid.typical_fit_note: Common for long-term care but may have lower reimbursement and network constraints.

Commercial.typical_fit_note: Can be attractive when in-network and authorized; admin burden can be high.

Private Pay.typical_fit_note: Often relevant for assisted living or respite care; requires deposit and responsible-party confirmation.

Out of Network Managed Medicaid.typical_fit_note: Usually not workable unless a special agreement exists.

VA Community Care.typical_fit_note: May be viable only where facility participates and authorization is documented.
